newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber falls in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber falls in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices fell in late trading on Thursday after buyers reduced bid levels, traders said.
"There were bids coming to the market today, but traders did not want to sell because it would not be profitable," said one trader.
"Bids were heard at 45.50 U.S. cents/lb in Medan, but traders there insisted on selling at 47.00 for August/September shipment," he said.
Traders said offer prices fell to 45.25 fob Palembang, Surabaya, Padang, Pontianak and Jambi.
"We wish that we knew what's going on in the market. But I think the development in Thailand is the main factor which has driven the market down," said another trader.
Thailand is selling rubber in cheaply following intervention to prop up prices.
